race.comment: HUGGIE (13) rode a hot speed here on debut three weeks ago and fought on gamely on the inside to hold second. Better for that and can get the job done this time at the featherweight. UNLOADING (3) returns and has been fitted with a smart trial win. Plenty to like about his debut campaign too - last seen tackling G3 company at the Gold Coast. Bright return anticipated. ERIMAR (12) has been thereabouts in his first two starts and should be hitting his straps now, and Philpot's claim could see her get as light as 49.5kg. Big watch. COMPEL (6) fired up a treat prior to her debut win here at the midweeks. Led pillar-to-post then and will likely be looking to repeat the dose.
